titles.title: Untitled (Pedernal)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: In this work, Pedernal is visible in a blue silhouette in the distance beneath a dark blue sky.  Large, formless red shapes fill much of the foreground, and a small patch of green can be seen in the lower-left corner.
